gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO MA AFTER EFFECTS - NEA ƐYƐ FOFORO
Version 9.2.8  -  October 2026
================================================================================

Seesei wobetumi de KASA 132 adi dwuma wɔ panel no mu, DEMON SLAYER THEME foforo a nkrante twitwa
button a wopia no wɔ hɔ, na layout ne Windows ho nsiesie ahodoɔ bi nso wɔ hɔ.

ANSA NA WOAHYƐ ASE
- Fa wo ZXP installer a wode di dwuma daa no sie version a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei no so, afei
  hyɛ After Effects ase bio prɛko.
- Wɔbɛkora wo nhyehyɛe, theme, presets ne expressions a woakora no.

FOFORO: PANEL NO WƆ KASA 132 MU
- Flex Nhyehyɛe > KASA seesei kyerɛ kasa 132, ne search adaka bi. Paw baako
  na panel no nyinaa bɛsesa: tabs, buttons, tooltips, nkrasɛm.
- Wɔde AI kyerɛɛ kasa biara aseɛ firii English panel no mu, na ɛnyɛ asɛmfua-asɛmfua nkyerɛaseɛ.
  Din a wohu wɔ wo project mu (layer din, effect din) bɛtena English mu
  sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛno nso ne After Effects bɛhyia.
- Wɔakyerɛ "nea ɛyɛ foforo" popup no nso aseɛ, firi release yi so kɔ.

FOFORO: DEMON SLAYER THEMES
- Flex Nhyehyɛe > THEME PAWBEA wɔ DEMON SLAYER kuw foforo a theme 11 wɔ mu:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen ne Kokushibo.
- Fa mouse no kɔ panel no so, na theme no adeɛ bi di wo akyi: nsuo,
  ogya, anyinam, afofantɔ, nhwiren ahaban, mununkum ne nea ɛkeka ho. Sɛ mouse no gyae a,
  ɛyera brɛoo.
- Pia button bi, na saa character no nkrante twitwa. Sɛ wokura benkum button no
  mu a, ɛkɔ so twitwa; sɛ wokura mu seconds 2.5 bɛyɛ a, ɛbɔ pae.
- Wɔayɛ no sɛ ɛnyɛ duru: effects no yɛ adwuma bere a wosɛn mouse anaa wopia nko ara, na
  ɛno ankasa yɛ mmrɛ wɔ kɔmputa a ɛyɛ brɛoo so. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosie kɔla ahorow nko ara a,
  dum AMBIENT EFFECTS wɔ Theme pawbea no mu.

NSAKRAEƐ: FLAT BUTTONS WƆ THEME BIARA MU
- Active ne buttons titiriw a ɛwɔ kɔla themes mu no nni gradient a ɛyɛ sum firi atifi
  kɔ ase bio. Wɔyɛ kɔla baako a ɛtrɛ a hyerɛn mmrɛ wɔ ho, enti
  ɛyɛ fɛ na wotumi kenkan no yiye.

NSIESIE
- License card ne "nea ɛyɛ foforo" popup no tumi bue bi so. Seesei wɔnnkata bi
  so da, na UPDATE badge no nso nkata buttons a ɛwɔ panel no
  atifi no bio.
- Wɔ UI SCALE 125% ne 150% so no, window bi (te sɛ Flex Nhyehyɛe) tumi tenten sen panel no,
  enti close button no firii ani so. Seesei window biara fata
  wɔ ɛkɛse biara mu.
- Windows: AutoCaptions tumi ka sɛ "NVIDIA DRIVER NO YƐ DADA DODO MA GPU
  CAPTIONS" wɔ card ne driver foforo (RTX 40 ne 50 series) so. Seesei ɛkenkan
  driver no CUDA mmoa no yiye na ɛde wo GPU no di dwuma.

NEA ANNSESA
- Licensing, activation ne link biara yɛ adwuma te sɛ nea na ɛte kane no.
- Tab ne adwinnie foforo biara yɛ adwuma te sɛ 9.2.7 mu no.
================================================================================

ult.message:
FLEX ULTIMATE MA PREMIERE PRO - NEA ƐYƐ FOFORO
Version 2.2.8  -  October 2026

CAPTION STACK captions seesei yɛ Motion Graphics templates a wotumi SESA a editor ankasa wɔ ho,
AUDIO STUDIO ne MARK AUDIO BEATS foforo wɔ hɔ, wobetumi de KASA 132 adi dwuma wɔ panel no mu,
UI SCALE aba ULTIMATE mu, na DEMON SLAYER THEMES foforo nso wɔ hɔ.

ANSA NA WOAHYƐ ASE
- Fa wo ZXP installer a wode di dwuma daa no sie version a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei no so, afei
  hyɛ Premiere Pro ase bio prɛko.
- Wɔbɛkora wo nhyehyɛe, theme ne presets.

FOFORO: CAPTION STACK - CAPTIONS A WOTUMI SESA (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Seesei wɔde captions no si hɔ sɛ Motion Graphics templates a wotumi sesa (Output >
  EDITABLE MOGRT, nea wɔahyɛ da no foforo wɔ Premiere Pro 2026 mu). Sɛ woresi hɔ wie a,
  sesa asɛmfua biara, font, kɔla, kɛse, beae, hyerɛn, outline, adaka,
  animation anaa bere wɔ Premiere Pro Essential Graphics panel mu.
- Output > MFONINI da so de asɛmfua biara si hɔ sɛ mfonini a ne ɔhwɛ te saa ara pɛ,
  sɛ ɛno na wopɛ a.
- Templates no ka panel no ho. Biribiara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wodownload.

FOFORO: CAPTION STACK EDITOR
- Preview no seesei kyerɛ wo video no frame ankasa wɔ caption biara ase.
- Twe caption bi na woayi no, fa corner no sesa ne kɛse na fa dot a ɛwɔ atifi no dan no,
  pia asɛmfua bi mprɛnu na woasesa. CAPTION NYINAA twe asɛmfua nyinaa bom, ASƐMFUA BAAKO
  twe asɛmfua baako pɛ.
- Paw sɛ nsakrae no bɛfa caption nyinaa anaa saa caption yi nko ara, na
  sie wo layouts na wode adi dwuma bio.
- GLOW looks foforo 10: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow ne Superb.

FOFORO: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Paw audio clip bi, paw effect na pia FA DI DWUMA. Biribiara yɛ adwuma wɔ
  wo kɔmputa so.
- Presets 30 a ɛyɛ pia baako: Nsuo mu, Bass Boost, Dan / Hall / Cathedral /
  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse ne nea ɛkeka ho. Fa effects pii
  sie bom sɛnea wopɛ, sesa wɔn nhyehyɛe anaa dum baako.
- Reverb kora ne dua: nne no bɛkɔ so ne clip no awiei akyi, na wɔde
  si hɔ sɛ biribiara a ɛwɔ wo timeline so renkyerɛw so.
- Adwinnie: Noise Remover, Voice Enhance, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Hum Remover, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Speed
  ne Pitch, Noise Gate, Extract Audio.
- STEMS MAKER kyekyɛ dwom bi mu yɛ vocals ne nnwom (anaa stems 4). Ɛdownload ne model
  bere a edi kan na ɛbisa wo kan.
- PREVIEW ma wotumi tie bɛyɛ seconds 8 a Original / Processed switch wɔ ho.
  Wɔde nea efi mu no gu audio track a ɛnni hwee so na wɔdum wo clip original no ne nne,
  wɔnpepa da.

FOFORO: MARK AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > MARK AUDIO BEATS)
- Paw music clip bi wɔ timeline so na pia MARK BEATS: Flex hunu beats no
  na ɛde sequence markers si so, ma w'atwa no nnwom no ahyia
  pɛpɛɛpɛ.
- Paw ALL hits, KICKS anaa SNARES, hyehyɛ sensitivity, na mark beat biara anaa
  beat a ɛto so 2 anaa 4 biara.
- REMOVE BEAT MARKERS pepa markers a Flex de besii hɔ nko ara. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ
  wo kɔmputa so.

FOFORO: PANEL NO WƆ KASA 132 MU
- Nhyehyɛe > KASA seesei kyerɛ kasa 132, ne search adaka bi. Tabs,
  buttons, tooltips ne nkrasɛm nyinaa sesa. "Nea ɛyɛ foforo" popup no nso wɔakyerɛ no
  aseɛ firi release yi so.
